newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 6.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones ended at 6,437.10 points, up 14.16 points. PLDT's ADR rose by $0 7/8 at $58 5/8.
* On Thursday, the peso closed at 26.293 to a U.S. dollar from 26.297.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,163.33, up 32.46.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was unchanged at 10.8125 pct.

* The national inflation rate whittled down to 4.5 percent in November from 4.7 percent in October, the National Statistics Office said. The rate is below government's expectations of 6.8 percent due to low food prices.
* The Philippine Times Journal said Benguet Corp posted a higher net loss of 91.2 million pesos for the first nine months of this year from 74 million pesos registered in the same period last year.
* The Journal added that Universal Leisure Club, wholly-owned subsidiary of Universal Rightfield, is raising 30.64 billion pesos from the slae of its propriety shares.

* The newspaper Malaya said All Asia Capital Corp sees seven unibanks as likely candidates for mergers or consolidations after the Central Bank called for another round of capital increase for all banks to improve their competitiveness.
* The Business Daily said Manila Electric Co has earmarked 31.05 billion pesos for its five-year expansion plan ending 2001.
* The Business Daily added that Uniwide Holdings Inc is negotiating talks with Petron Corp for the establishment of convenience stores in strategic gasoline stations nationwide.
